examples.explanation: The two recognized classes distinguish retained names used as preferred IUPAC names from those recommended for general nomenclature.
The named retained structures illustrate the unrestricted default and the stated no-substitution and limited-substitution exceptions.

symbol_declarations.description: A retained name is one of the exceptions for which no substitution is allowed.
A functional parent retained name is anisole or tert-butoxy and cannot be substituted.
A functional parent retained name is formic acid or formyl and has limited substitutability.
